EARLY ACCESS / ANDROID

Try Revisen.

Connect, then get curious.

Get a reachable Revisen server URL from your test organiser and enter it in Connection settings. You can then create an account or explore the server’s sample workspace.

This is a server-dependent pilot. Without a reachable backend, the learning workspace will not work. Optional AI transcription and explanations need a configured Gemini service; they do not establish mastery or grade all question types.
